title: 3936. Minimum Swaps to Move Zeros to End

examples.explanation: We perform the following swap operations: Swap nums[0] and nums[3], giving nums = [3, 1, 0, 0, 12]. Swap nums[2] and nums[4], giving nums = [3, 1, 12, 0, 0]. Thus, the answer is 2.
We perform the following swap operations: Swap nums[0] and nums[3], giving nums = [2, 1, 0, 0]. Thus, the answer is 1.
The array already satisfies the condition. Therefore, no swap operations are needed.
